av_offset.derivation: golden_video.mp4 audio track lags golden_raw.wav by ~17.6 ms (R1 A/V check). Frames assumed synced to the video audio track; total expected video->audio uncertainty ~+/-25 ms (frame quantization + source A/V + AAC residual).

annotation_method.region_pass: continuous-contact spans (slides / dense sweeps) logged from pass1+pass2

notes: Vision determines event identity; audio refines exact timing (Phase 2, +/-40 ms).
Game judgment text appears 0-2 frames AFTER the physical touch; physical contact sound leads the on-screen judgment.
Events marked status=rejected_noncontact are audio transients proven NOT to be player contacts (airborne hand / ambience).
Dense passages (R1-R4, R6-R8) contain embedded sub-taps that could not be decomposed at 60 fps; they are covered by the listed events + region envelopes.
